batch: 5 (chs 21-29, kings, false prophets, the figs, the letter to the exiles)

units.characteristics: justice to the poor as knowing God; prosperity deafness
units.gist: GEM - the oracles to the kings; Josiah 'did JUSTICE AND RIGHTEOUSNESS... he JUDGED THE CAUSE OF THE POOR and needy; then it was well. IS NOT THIS TO KNOW ME? declares the LORD' (knowing God = doing justice to the weak); vs Jehoiakim with 'eyes and heart only for dishonest gain'; 'I spoke to you in YOUR PROSPERITY, but you said, I WILL NOT LISTEN - this has been your way from your youth'

units.characteristics: false shepherds who scatter; the Righteous Branch, 'the LORD is our righteousness'
units.gist: 'woe to the SHEPHERDS who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture... you have not attended to them'; the promise 'I will raise up for David a RIGHTEOUS BRANCH... and this is his name: THE LORD IS OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS' - the true shepherd-king who is himself the people's righteousness

units.characteristics: false prophets of their own minds; the council of the LORD; no hiding from the God who fills all; the word as fire
units.gist: GEM - 'my HEART IS BROKEN within me... because of the LORD and his holy words'; the prophets 'speak VISIONS OF THEIR OWN MINDS, not from the mouth of the LORD', telling the stubborn 'it shall be well with you'; 'who has stood in the COUNCIL of the LORD?'; 'am I a God at hand and not far away? can a man HIDE in secret places so that I cannot see him? do I not FILL heaven and earth?'; 'IS NOT MY WORD LIKE FIRE, and like a HAMMER that breaks the rock?'

units.characteristics: God gives a heart to know him; the whole-hearted return
units.gist: THE GEM - the two baskets of figs (good/bad); of the exiles God says 'I will give them A HEART TO KNOW ME, that I am the LORD, and they shall be my people and I will be their God, for they shall RETURN TO ME WITH THEIR WHOLE HEART' - the heart-to-know-God given by God himself; whole-hearted return as its fruit

units.characteristics: the persistently-rejected word; the cup all must drink
units.gist: 'for TWENTY-THREE YEARS the word of the LORD has come to me, and I have spoken persistently, BUT YOU HAVE NOT LISTENED'; the summons 'TURN NOW, every one from his evil way' unheeded; the seventy years; the CUP OF THE WINE OF WRATH that all the nations must drink - none goes unpunished, 'shall you go unpunished?' (universal accountability); the persistently-offered, persistently-refused word

units.characteristics: the prophet's composure under the threat of death; relenting still possible
units.gist: GEM - Jeremiah's temple sermon and near-death trial; 'IT MAY BE they will listen and every one TURN... that I may RELENT'; seized and threatened with death, his composure - 'behold, I am IN YOUR HANDS; do with me as seems good and right to you. ONLY KNOW that if you put me to death you will bring INNOCENT BLOOD upon yourselves'; the elders recall Hezekiah who 'FEARED THE LORD and entreated his favour, and the LORD RELENTED'; but Uriah killed (the real cost)

units.characteristics: trusting a comforting lie; the test of true vs false prophecy; the honest 'Amen'
units.gist: the yoke-sign (submit to Babylon and LIVE); 'do not listen to the prophets... it is a LIE'; Hananiah's false 'peace in two years'; Jeremiah's honest 'AMEN! may the LORD do so' (genuinely wishing the good news true though he knows it false); the test - 'when the word comes to pass, then it will be known the LORD sent the prophet'; 'you have made this people TRUST IN A LIE'; the wooden yoke broken becomes iron

units.characteristics: seeking the welfare of the place of exile; plans for a future and hope; seeking God with the whole heart
units.gist: THE GEM - the letter to the exiles: 'build houses... SEEK THE WELFARE of the city where I have sent you, for in ITS welfare you will find YOUR welfare'; 'FOR I KNOW THE PLANS I have for you, plans for WELFARE and not for evil, to give you A FUTURE AND A HOPE'; 'you will call upon me and I will hear you; YOU WILL SEEK ME AND FIND ME, WHEN YOU SEEK ME WITH ALL YOUR HEART' - flourishing in exile; God's good purpose; whole-hearted seeking that finds
